whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Marx Fitness,

I noticed your fitness ecosystem has a strong presence in Kankarbagh, but your current website lacks a seamless mobile booking and conversion flow for your multi-tier programs.

Maine aapke fitness brand ke liye ek high-converting custom website demo design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp batch enrollment, online coaching plans, aur interactive store integrate kiya hai:

🔗 https://www.marxfitness.info/

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Marx Fitness, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke fitness ecosystem ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with mobile-first speed, direct WhatsApp enrollment, and an easy showcase of your Aura programs and Academy courses in Kankarbagh. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual pricing, aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
